summary:
Experienced Chartered Accountant with strong expertise in audit, taxation, and financial controls, delivering
reliable compliance and process‑driven solutions across CA firms, Manufacturing environments, Government
Authorities and Corporates. Adept at leading audits, evaluating internal controls, preparing financial reports,
and advising management on regulatory and process improvements. Known for structured documentation,
disciplined execution, and the ability to manage diverse assignments with accuracy and professionalism.

• GST compliance, ITR filing, tax audit, advisory for SMEs.
• Financial planning & statutory compliance consulting.
